fields.name: objectid
fields.description: {"value":"The ObjectID is a system-generated unique identifier for each record in an ArcGIS Online feature layer or table. It ensures that every feature has a distinct reference, which is essential for editing, querying, and managing data.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: id
fields.alias: Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS) Station Identifier
fields.description: {"value":"The unique identifier assigned by National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's (NOAA) Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS) to the water level active station. This identifier is used to retrieve station predictions, metadata, and related products.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: name
fields.description: {"value":"The official name of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) water level active station. Station names typically reference nearby geographic features or navigation landmarks.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: state
fields.description: {"value":"The U.S. state or territory in which the water level prediction station is located. This field supports geographic organization and regional analysis of stations.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: {"value":"The geographic latitude of the water level active station expressed in decimal degrees. Latitude defines the station’s north–south position for mapping and spatial analysis.","fieldValueType":"coordinate"}

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: {"value":"The geographic longitude of the water level active station expressed in decimal degrees. Longitude defines the station’s east–west position for mapping and coastal applications.","fieldValueType":"coordinate"}

fields.name: data
fields.description: {"value":"A reference link to the water level active data associated with the station. This field provides access to National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) time series, forecasts, or downloadable data products.","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: metaapi
fields.alias: Station Metadata Application Programming Interface (API) Endpoint
fields.description: {"value":"A web service endpoint that returns detailed metadata for the water level active station. The Application Programming Interface (API) typically includes station attributes, datum information, and documentation.","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: dataapi
fields.alias: Water Level Data Application Programming Interface (API) Endpoint
fields.description: {"value":"A web service endpoint providing programmatic access to water level active historic data. This Application Programming Interface (API) supports automated retrieval of forecasts and related information.","fieldValueType":"description"}
